meta.note: Full unified registry (SHVR-rated schools UNION every school appearing in any of the 4 CSR files) by CURRENT (post-2023-split) district. total_school_count is the real denominator behind each _pct field — includes schools SHVR never rated, so these percentages and counts are meaningful for all 41 current districts, not just the 26 SHVR covered. has_shvr_rating / in_shvr_count show how much of that total actually has a star rating.
